caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object resembling a woven textile or rug, predominantly featuring shades of pink, green, black, and white. The composition consists of a repeating grid pattern, with horizontal and vertical black lines intersecting to form a series of squares. Inside each square, there are rounded bubble-like pink shapes. At the intersections of the black lines, there are prominent circular black forms. The four corners, as well as the middle points of the edges, have tufts of green and black, creating a fringed or tasselled effect. The edges of the rectangle are bordered by wavy fringes combining pink, white, and green colors. Small red dots arranged in patterns appear near the corners within green areas. The overall appearance suggests a soft texture with a tactile surface, and the background is plain and unadorned, leaving the focus on the central textile design.
title: Mat
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
